observation.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
echo "=== /map headers ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -D - -o /tmp/mapbody https://app.localhost/map; echo; wc -c < /tmp/mapbody
echo "=== follow redirects ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -skL --resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /tmp/appfull -w "final=%{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n" https://app.localhost/
wc -c < /tmp/appfull; head -c 400 /tmp/appfull
